name: handoff
description: Save a session handoff to disk and restore it in a fresh session by id. /handoff saves and returns an id; /handon <id> resumes; /ahandoff [prompt] (= /handoff auto) hands off automatically at a context threshold (handoff → /clear → /handon → continue); /handoff panel opens the pane.

threshold.title: Auto handoff: context threshold (%)
threshold.description: Past this context usage the auto handoff kicks in (handoff → /clear → /handon → continue).

checkEvery.title: Auto handoff: check every N tool calls
checkEvery.description: How often, in tool calls, the context usage is read mid-turn.

autoOn.title: Auto handoff: armed at session start
autoOn.description: Start every session with the auto handoff loop armed.

resumeAfterLimit.title: Auto handoff: resume after the 5h rate limit
resumeAfterLimit.description: When an armed loop's turn dies on the 5-hour limit, send the continuation prompt 2 minutes after the window resets.

staleDays.title: Handoffs: mark stale after N days
staleDays.description: Handoffs older than this are drawn as stale in the pane and removed by Delete stale.

segment.title: Status line: show the 🪃 segment
segment.description: Show the context percentage segment in the prompt hint line; a click opens the pane.
